name: Great Valley Skeleton Horse
description: A horse the valley kept after everything else was taken back. It is light, quick and hollow, it eats only what it is made of, and it is hostile to anything that climbs on it after dark until somebody gives it a bone. One bone is enough, once, for good.
notes: DRAFT. Not loadable yet: horsegenetics.skeleton (Skl), the Dbone diet allele and the Bne drop allele do not exist. A breed file that names a gene or allele this build lacks is warned about and that locus alone is dropped, so copying this in early would give a plain Feral-looking horse, not an error. See intake/Undead horse conversion.txt.
Gene key and allele tokens for the undeath locus (horsegenetics.skeleton, Skl) are PROPOSED. Change them here and in the gene file together; the token is the file format.

No spawn: cowboy or stable, so the breed is unsellable and never placed in a building (D23). No price, no biomes, no spawn_ground, no spawn_time: it heads no wild herd (D18). spawn_egg only. magical_variant is false so a magical herd is never rolled onto it.

Passification is Prm/Prm (D13): permanent, at any age, one minecraft:bone. offering 14 is the index minecraft:bone gets when it is appended to PassificationGene.OFFERINGS after cake (13). If anything else is appended first, this number moves - it is an index into a closed list, so check it against the list when the gene is edited. amount [1,1] pins 'one bone'. Duration and cooldown are left unbanded, as nightmare.json does, since a permanent route never reads them.
Aggression is Anp/Anp (D16): hostile to riders after dark. Passification's veto covers targeting AND fleeing (see nightmare.json's note); check that it holds for this allele.

Diet is Dbone/Dbone (D17): eats bones and heals from them the way a metal-eater eats one metal. It is the same item as the passification offering on purpose. Needs a new Diet entry and the DietGene token appended to TOKENS.
Drops are Bne/Bne (D15): bones instead of leather. Proposed 1 to 3 bones; needs the allele added to MagicItemDropGene. The locus key horsegenetics.magic_item_drop is MagicItemDropGene.KEY.

Stats: speed 8, jump 7 (light and quick), health 2 (fragile), pull 3. Size [0.86, 0.95] (D26) matches the vanilla undead horse, which vanilla renders at about 0.909 of a horse; a minecraft:horse at [0.95, 1.05] would come out about 10 percent bigger than the animal it replaced. Health scores run from about 22.5 hp at 5 to 50.5 hp at 10 (BreedStatCurve), so health 2 is well under the baseline; tune it once seen in play.
Eyes, mane, glow and every other cosmetic locus are left to the founder tables' defaults on purpose; they can be pinned once the look is designed.

Coat: NOT written. The look is the horse's own coat with a binary alpha mask cut out of it (Appendix C, D27, D28): the coat is the copied vanilla skeleton sheet with its own alpha kept (D27, revised); waits on the sheet-stamping op and the copy.

Eyes (D29): pure black. Sclera Blk/Blk at both eyes is the existing black sclera allele. The iris needs EyeColourGene to gain a BLACK row (EyeHue.BLACK, token Blk, already exists for the sclera): append it, so no existing horse changes, and pin Blk/Blk at both iris loci. Vanilla's undead horses have plain black eyes; no glow loci are pinned, so the eyes do not glow.

Particle (D30): Bflm/Bflm is ParticleGene's soul_fire_flame, blue soul flames. The site is banded to 2, the index of 'hooves' in ParticleGene.SITES (head, spine, hooves, front_hooves, back_hooves, tail), so the flames come off all four hooves. The band key is the epigenetic value name 'site' (EpiValue.category). Check the band accepts a category index the way passification's 'offering' does. Count and colour are left to the founder roll; colour is probably ignored by a fixed vanilla particle.

Water (D32): Gil/Gil on horsegenetics.magic_water_breathing. This gene is GRADED (a percentage written on each copy, about a quarter a copy, 'usually'), not the absolute underwater_breathing traversal flag that simply refills air every tick. If 'a skeleton cannot drown' is the intent, the graded gene will not deliver it unless the copy's percentage is banded very high; decide between banding it, or an effects-block traversal flag. UNVERIFIED which of the two the owner meant.

Strains (D31): Bleached 65, Weathered 35. The strains are EMPTY: a strain's own genes and stats are where the two looks differ, and the coat is not written yet, so they differ in nothing today. Verify the parser and BreedFilesTest accept a strain with empty genes and stats; if not, give each a placeholder. Bleached is clean bone; Weathered is stained, darker bone. Both share the alpha mask (D27, D28).
